title: Tail-labelled junction deletion contribution
statement:
Let X be a scheme, I a linearly ordered type, U : I -> X.Opens, F an abelian-group-valued presheaf, S a SiteCechComplex for the maps U_i -> X [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex], p a natural number, s a degree-(p+1) cochain, and t : Fin (p+2) -> I. Use the stable sorting filter, partial sorting filter, and junction map [def-pc-alternating-cech-sorting-operators]. Define E and B by the following displayed formulas. The sum of junction-labelled deletions with a < r equals minus the sum of advanced partial sorting contributions B_(a+1).

let E := fun (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (p + 2))) (a : Fin (p + 2))
        (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (p + 2))) (r : Fin (p + 3)) ↦
      ((-1 : ℤ) ^ a.val * (Equiv.Perm.sign τ : ℤ)) •
        F.map (S.indexMap t (cechJunction σ τ a)).op
          ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val •
            F.map (S.indexMap (t ∘ cechJunction σ τ a) r.succAbove).op
              (s ((t ∘ cechJunction σ τ a) ∘ r.succAbove)))
    let T := ∑ σ, ∑ a, ∑ τ, ∑ r,
      if ((cechStableSort t σ ∧ cechPartialSort σ τ a) ∧
          cechJunction σ τ a r = σ a) ∧ a.val < r.val then E σ a τ r else 0
    let B : ℕ → S.cochains F (p + 1) := fun a t ↦
      ∑ σ, ∑ τ, if cechStableSort t σ ∧
          (∀ k, k.val < a → τ k = σ k) ∧
          (∀ i j, a ≤ i.val → i < j → τ i < τ j) then
        (Equiv.Perm.sign τ : ℤ) • F.map (S.indexMap t τ).op (s (t ∘ τ)) else 0
    T = - ∑ a : Fin (p + 2), B (a.val + 1) t

proof.text: For each sigma and a, use unique partial sorting at a and a+1 to collapse the two permutation filters to their unique tau and rho. This uses no stable-sort uniqueness; the stable-sort condition is retained as an outer decidable filter.

Let b=tau^{-1}(sigma(a)). The fixed prefix and injectivity give b>=a. Unfolding cechJunction proves that its tail copy of sigma(a) occurs precisely at r=b+1. Advancing the partial sort identifies the tuple after deleting r with rho and gives rho=tau*(cycleIcc a b).symm.

By multiplicativity of permutation sign, sign_symm, and Mathlib Fin.sign_cycleIcc_of_le, sign(rho)=sign(tau)*(-1)^(b-a). The identity (-1)^a*(-1)^b=(-1)^(b-a) follows from b=a+(b-a) and (-1)^(2a)=1. Therefore the deletion coefficient is -sign(rho).

Compose the two index maps by subsingleton elimination in the category of opens. Apply op_comp and functoriality of F, then the deleted-tuple equality, to identify the transported section with the pullback indexed by rho. Additivity moves integer scalars through F.map.

Collapse the unique tau, rho and r finite sums with Finset.sum_ite_eq'. For a failed stable-sort filter both sides vanish. Commute the sigma and a sums and distribute negation to obtain the stated equality. Empty I has no such tuple; repeated values in t introduce no ambiguity because the argument uses original labels.

theorem cechFirstSortingJunctionTailContribution (X : Scheme.{u}) {I : Type v}
    [LinearOrder I] (U : I → X.Opens)
    (F : X.Opensᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{w})
    (S : SiteCechComplex U (fun i ↦ homOfLE (le_top : U i ≤ ⊤)))
    (p : ℕ) (s : S.cochains F (p + 1)) (t : Fin (p + 2) → I) :
    let E := fun (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (p + 2))) (a : Fin (p + 2))
        (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (p + 2))) (r : Fin (p + 3)) ↦
      ((-1 : ℤ) ^ a.val * (Equiv.Perm.sign τ : ℤ)) •
        F.map (S.indexMap t (cechJunction σ τ a)).op
          ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val •
            F.map (S.indexMap (t ∘ cechJunction σ τ a) r.succAbove).op
              (s ((t ∘ cechJunction σ τ a) ∘ r.succAbove)))
    let T := ∑ σ, ∑ a, ∑ τ, ∑ r,
      if ((cechStableSort t σ ∧ cechPartialSort σ τ a) ∧
          cechJunction σ τ a r = σ a) ∧ a.val < r.val then E σ a τ r else 0
    let B : ℕ → S.cochains F (p + 1) := fun a t ↦
      ∑ σ, ∑ τ, if cechStableSort t σ ∧
          (∀ k, k.val < a → τ k = σ k) ∧
          (∀ i j, a ≤ i.val → i < j → τ i < τ j) then
        (Equiv.Perm.sign τ : ℤ) • F.map (S.indexMap t τ).op (s (t ∘ τ)) else 0
    T = - ∑ a : Fin (p + 2), B (a.val + 1) t
